settings.tools.intro: Each program Daoris runs beside its agents is the system's, from PATH; a version Daoris downloads into its home and verifies; or a file you name. Nothing changes until you press Use, and a session already running keeps the tools it started with.
settings.tools.terminal: The same file as `daoris tool list` and `daoris tool use` at a terminal.
settings.tools.fileProblem: Daoris's tools file does not read, so every tool is refused until it is fixed: {{problem}}
settings.tools.why.git: Daoris's own git: session trees, landings, reviews and bringing up to date. A session's git is the same one.
settings.tools.why.node: Plugins and the servers they hand sessions, a check on what sessions write, and the agents npm installs. Its npm and npx come with it.
settings.tools.why.az: The Azure DevOps plugin's pull requests.
settings.tools.fileHint: A program on this machine, by its whole path. It is asked its version before it is set.
settings.tools.systemNone: {{name}} is not on this machine's PATH. Managed or Custom gives Daoris one.
settings.tools.licence: {{licence}} licence, downloaded from {{hosts}} by this machine. Daoris redistributes nothing.
settings.tools.noVersions: No list names a version of {{name}} for this machine. Look for updates fetches the lists, and Add location… adds one.
settings.tools.refusedVersions: Refused, since two lists disagree on each: {{versions}}. Nothing is fetched until one of them changes.
settings.tools.gitFirst: What a switch of Git changes is asked of the Git it would run, so this version is downloaded first.
settings.tools.noPicker: This window has no file picker. Type the program's whole path.
settings.tools.deleteSays: Confirm delete removes {{name}} {{version}} from Daoris's home. A download brings it back.
settings.tools.running: {{name}} {{version}} is downloading. It is verified before anything uses it.
settings.tools.ended.downloaded: {{name}} {{version}} is downloaded and verified. Nothing switched.
settings.tools.ended.stopped: The download of {{name}} {{version}} was stopped. Nothing was kept, and nothing switched.
settings.tools.switch.title: What this switch changes
settings.tools.switch.reading: Asking each Git how it reads a checkout…
settings.tools.switch.same: Both read a checkout the same way.
settings.tools.switch.differs: The two read a checkout differently. Where your own Git and Daoris's work in one checkout, files can show as changed:
settings.tools.switch.unknown: What it changes cannot be said: {{problem}}
settings.tools.locations.title: Resource locations
settings.tools.locations.hint: Each is a list of tools' versions and where each downloads, read before the one built in. A list is trusted as its host is: add only one you trust.
settings.tools.locations.none: Only the list built in is read. Add location… reads a newer list, a team's own, or a mirror, before it.
settings.tools.locations.noBuiltIn: This install carries no list built in, so only the locations are read.
settings.tools.locations.never: Never fetched, so it names nothing yet.
settings.tools.locations.added: {{address}} is listed. Look for updates fetches it.
settings.tools.locations.removed: {{address}} is removed. What was downloaded from it stays.
